_divergence: Deliberately diverges from the recorded Python reference, which said pdf_type=text_based, confidence=0.875, pages_needing_ocr=[] and routed every page to the local extractor. mixed_long.pdf has an image on every third page (0-indexed 2, 5, ... 23) and no text layer on those pages, so the Python answer sent 8 blank pages downstream. Cause: pdf-inspector had already measured which pages need OCR, then let a document-level label erase the measurement -- it calls a document text_based once the share of text pages clears text_page_ratio_threshold (16/24 = 0.667 > 0.6 here) and unconditionally discards pages_needing_ocr for that label (detector.rs: PdfType::TextBased => Vec::new()). doc-router now disables that branch (text_page_ratio_threshold: 1.0) and derives the label from the page list instead (classify::label_from_pages), so the document is mixed and the 8 image pages route to OCR. confidence 0.875 -> 0.7 is pdf-inspector's own constant for the Mixed branch, not a measurement that changed.
